lines.text: Gaza will lose her king, a mixed race will occupy Ashdod, and the Philistines will become like a clan in Judah.
Zion's King comes righteous, victorious and humble, riding on a donkey, and the LORD will camp around His house.
The LORD will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the King's dominion will reach from the Nile.
The LORD will rouse Zion's sons against the sons of Egypt, and the LORD of Hosts will shield them.
